messages:
Nora Patel: Heads-up — a customer POC stalled because routing sent their 9-month commit straight to Sales Ops. We should be routing anything >=6 months to Deal Desk.
Sam Ortiz: Agreed. What fields do we have today? I think CPQ sets `Special_Pricing__c` and `Manual_Review__c`. No commit length field in routing.
Eli Zhang: We already capture commit length on the Opportunity: `Commit_Length_Months__c`. We just didn't include it in the approval rule.
Jamal Rivera: Proposal: New boolean `Route_To_DealDesk__c` computed by CPQ with logic: `Commit_Length_Months__c >= 6 OR Discount__c > 0.15 OR Legal_Amendment_Requested__c = TRUE`. Then downstream queue just reads that flag. Keeps routing simple.
Nora Patel: I like computed flag. Also set `DealDesk_Reason__c` with values like `commit-length`, `discount`, `legal-term`, `security-request`, `manual` so we can filter queue.
Sam Ortiz: SLA needs to be explicit. Recommend: `Approval_SLA_Hours__c` values: 24 (standard small deals), 48 (mid), 72 (enterprise/legal). CPQ should populate SLA based on ARR estimate and presence of `Legal_Amendment_Requested__c`.
Eli Zhang: How do we map ARR? Use `Estimated_ARR__c` on quote. Example rule: if Estimated_ARR__c > 250000 -> 72, if >50000 -> 48 else 24.
Jamal Rivera: Also add `Template_Suggested_Id__c` when route to Deal Desk so Legal has a starting point. We can default to NDA or SOW templates.
Nora Patel: Can someone add a quick SOQL we can run in sandbox to validate computed fields?
Sam Ortiz: Sure —```sql
SELECT Id, Name, Commit_Length_Months__c, Discount__c, Route_To_DealDesk__c, DealDesk_Reason__c, Approval_SLA_Hours__c FROM Quote WHERE Id = 'q-9876'
```
Eli Zhang: I'll create a sandbox patch to compute the flag and populate reasons + SLA. Will run tests tomorrow.
Jamal Rivera: One more: escalation path. If `Approval_SLA_Hours__c` < now - CreatedDate AND no response, auto-escalate to DealDesk lead via email and Slack. Need a boolean field `Auto_Escalated__c`.
deal-bot: created ticket DD-1175 for CPQ routing + SLA fields (owner: @Eli Zhang)  https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/DD-1175
Nora Patel: Thanks. Owners: Eli -> ticket & sandbox; Sam -> validation SOQLs and test cases; Jamal -> legal template list. I'll coordinate stakeholder review after sandbox tests. :pray:
Sam Ortiz: I'll drop test cases and a tiny checklist in this thread once done.
Eli Zhang: ETA for sandbox deploy: tomorrow 10am PT. Will post results here.
Nora Patel: If everything looks good we'll flip the flag in staging next week. :rocket:
